narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed during the evening hours in a warm and humid airmass. The thunderstorms persisted into the overnight hours.
ev: Five to 7 inches of rain caused widespread flash flooding across much of Franklin County. Several roads and culverts were damaged due to the rushing water.
Rising waters forced a rescue of two people camping on a sand bar in the Whitewater River.
A culvert and a portion of Richland Creek Road were washed out.
A vehicle was washed off a roadway along Blue Creek Road. The rushing water also caused road and culvert damage.
Wolf Creek rose six feet out of its banks and caused widespread flash flooding along Wolf Creek Road. Two people were killed when a small cabin they were staying in was washed away.
